selection.quote: “Traffic” means pedestrians, ridden or herded animals, vehicles and other conveyances either singly or together using any highway for purposes of travel.
selection.reason: The definition enumerates the road users that make up traffic: pedestrians, vehicles and other conveyances, with highway use for travel being a contextual condition rather than membership.

“Bicycle” means a device propelled by human power upon which a person may ride

classifications.reason: Bicycles are excluded from vehicle as devices moved by human power, but traffic admits other conveyances besides vehicles, and a bicycle is a device upon which a person may ride.

quotes.words: vehicles
“Vehicle” means every device in, upon or by which any person or property is or may be transported or drawn upon a highway

classifications.reason: A bus is a device in which persons are transported upon a highway, so it is a vehicle.

“Pedestrian” means a person afoot, a person in a manual or motorized wheelchair, or a person on an electric personal assistive mobility device as defined in NRS 482.029.

classifications.reason: Traffic admits a child only as a pedestrian, and every member of ru.child is by its contract a pedestrian, so every admitted child already carries the included class ru.pedestrian.
